name: 0 · The Fool
title: 0 · The Fool
imagery: A wild green figure with horns leaps through swirling spirals of color, carrying a cup and a burning pinecone wand. Around him are a dove, a vulture, a butterfly, a tiger nuzzling his leg, a crocodile beneath and bunches of grapes. Everything is in motion, bursting with life.
meaning: The Thoth Fool is the raw, creative breath before anything takes form. He is spring, wild energy and divine madness: the willingness to leap without knowing. This card invites you to trust the impulse, embrace the unknown and let life surprise you. Something completely new is possible.
numerology: Zero is the void of infinite potential from which everything comes.
affirmation: I leap with joy into the unknown.

ctx.past: A leap of faith in your past opened your life to new possibilities. That wild energy is still in you.
ctx.present: Pure potential surrounds you now. Act on inspiration and stay open to the unexpected.
ctx.future: A fresh, unpredictable beginning is coming. Be ready to leap.
ctx.challenge: Recklessness or refusing all structure can scatter your energy.
ctx.advice: Trust the impulse. Say yes to the adventure.
ctx.self: You feel free, spontaneous and full of possibility.
ctx.others: Someone unpredictable or inspiring is around you.
ctx.hopes: You hope for freedom and fear chaos. Both are part of creation.
ctx.love: Love is spontaneous, playful and new.
ctx.work: An unconventional venture or bold new direction.
ctx.spirit: Your guides call you to divine play.
ctx.release: Release control and the need to plan everything.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of commitment.
ctx.gift: Your gift is fearless openness to life.

name: I · The Magician
title: I · The Magus
imagery: A winged, youthful figure based on Mercury hangs balanced in space, juggling tools that float around him: wand, cup, sword, coin, scroll, pen. A caduceus rises behind him, and a sly ape crouches below, mimicking his work.
meaning: The Magus is the messenger, the master of words and tools. He represents intelligence, skill and the power to communicate and create through will. The ape warns that skill can turn into trickery. Use your talents with integrity and focus.
numerology: One is the single point of will that begins creation.
affirmation: I use my skills and words with integrity.

ctx.past: Your intelligence and skill opened doors in the past.
ctx.present: Communication and skill are your tools now. Use them wisely.
ctx.future: An opportunity to show your talents is coming.
ctx.advice: Speak clearly and act with intention.
ctx.others: A persuasive communicator is involved; check the facts.
ctx.hopes: You hope to be heard and fear being misunderstood.
ctx.spirit: Your guides ask you to align your words with truth.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be the trickster within.

name: II · The High Priestess
title: II · The Priestess
imagery: A veiled goddess sits within a web of light, a bow across her knees. Crystals, flowers and fruits gather at her feet, and a camel crosses the desert below. She is bathed in silver moonlight.
meaning: The Priestess is the pure, independent inner light. She connects the highest spiritual source with the world below. This card asks you to trust your intuition, keep your spiritual independence and listen within.
affirmation: I trust the pure light of my intuition.

ctx.past: Your intuition guided you through an earlier time.
ctx.others: A mysterious or spiritual person is involved.
ctx.love: A soul connection or need for independence.

name: III · The Empress
title: III · The Empress
imagery: A crowned queen sits on a throne with arms raised like flames, holding a lotus. A pelican feeds its young with its own blood at her feet, and a shield bearing a double-headed eagle rests beside her. Moons and birds surround her.
meaning: The Thoth Empress is love, beauty and creative abundance. She is the gate through which life enters the world. This card brings fertility, grace and the power to nurture. Love generously and create.
numerology: Three is creation born from union.
affirmation: I create with love and grace.

ctx.past: Love and nurturing shaped your past.
ctx.others: A nurturing woman or mother figure helps.
ctx.spirit: Your guides bless you with grace.

name: IV · The Emperor
title: IV · The Emperor
imagery: A fiery, crowned ruler sits with legs crossed, rams on either side of him and a lamb with a banner at his feet. A shield with a double-headed eagle rests by him, and a bee appears on his scepter. He blazes with red and gold.
meaning: The Thoth Emperor is energy organized into power. He brings leadership, ambition and the drive to establish order. Use your authority wisely and build something that lasts.
numerology: Four is the foundation of order.
affirmation: I lead with energy and wisdom.

ctx.love: A protective but possibly controlling partner.
ctx.spirit: Your guides call you to responsible power.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of weakness.

name: V · The Hierophant
title: V · The Hierophant
imagery: A robed figure sits enthroned on a bull, with a child figure dancing within a star at his heart. A woman holding a sword stands before him, elephants guard the throne and the four creatures watch from the corners. A window of light frames them.
meaning: The Thoth Hierophant is the revealer of hidden wisdom. He teaches through initiation, inner voice and a new understanding of old truths. This card asks you to seek spiritual knowledge and share it.
numerology: Five is the bridge between worlds.
affirmation: I hear and share inner wisdom.

ctx.past: A teacher or initiation shaped you.
ctx.future: Spiritual teaching or revelation is coming.
ctx.advice: Seek wisdom from within and from teachers.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be spiritual pride.

name: VI · The Lovers
title: VI · The Lovers
imagery: A hooded hermit figure joins a king and queen of opposite colors in a sacred marriage. A blindfolded Cupid aims overhead, children carry symbols below, and a lion and eagle face each other. An orphic egg wrapped in a serpent rests at the bottom.
meaning: The Thoth Lovers is the alchemical marriage of opposites. It speaks of union, choice and the integration of different parts of yourself or of two people. Bring together what was divided.

ctx.past: A union or choice shaped your path.
ctx.others: A partner or ally is important.
ctx.spirit: Your guides bless the sacred marriage.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be split loyalties.

name: VII · The Chariot
title: VII · The Chariot
imagery: An armored charioteer sits within a canopied chariot, holding a glowing grail-like disk. Four sphinxes pull the chariot, each a blend of the four creatures. He sits still while everything moves around him.
meaning: The Thoth Chariot is the protected quest. The charioteer carries something sacred and moves forward with determination. Victory comes from holding your purpose steady.
affirmation: I move forward carrying what is sacred.

ctx.past: A determined effort carried you forward.
ctx.present: Keep your purpose steady and advance.
ctx.advice: Protect your purpose and move forward.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be emotional armor.

name: VIII · Strength
title: XI · Lust
imagery: A naked woman rides a many-headed lion, leaning back in ecstasy and raising a flaming cup. The beast's heads look in different directions. The scene glows with heat and energy.
meaning: Lust in the Thoth deck is joyful strength: not taming passion but riding it with ecstasy. It speaks of vitality, courage and the creative power of desire. Embrace life fully and fearlessly.
numerology: Eleven, the number of magical force and transformation.
affirmation: I ride my passion with joy and courage.

ctx.past: Passion and courage fueled your past.
ctx.future: A burst of energy and joy is coming.
ctx.spirit: Your guides awaken your life force.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be untamed instincts.

name: IX · The Hermit
title: IX · The Hermit
imagery: A cloaked hermit holds a lamp with a sun inside it, surrounded by wheat. An orphic egg wrapped in a serpent floats beside him, and a three-headed dog follows at his heels. Green and gold dominate.
meaning: The Thoth Hermit carries the light of wisdom into the darkness. He represents inner illumination and the quiet power of a mind that has ripened. Seek your own guidance.

ctx.future: A period of reflection is coming.

name: X · Wheel of Fortune
title: X · Fortune
imagery: A ten-spoked wheel spins amid lightning and stars. A sphinx sits atop it with a sword, while a dog-headed figure rises and a crocodile-like creature descends. Purple and blue energy swirls behind.
meaning: Fortune is the constant motion of life. Change is coming, and luck can shift quickly. Seize the moment and adapt.
affirmation: I embrace change and seize opportunity.

ctx.past: A change of fortune shaped your past.
ctx.advice: Go with the flow and act.
ctx.self: You feel the winds of change.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be feeling powerless.
